title: Resolv.Global: Bilingual Patient Services Representative
text: Headquarters: Ciudad de México, Mexico URL: https://resolv.global We are hiring Bilingual Patient Services Representatives to join a growing healthcare support team in a fully remote role based in Mexico. In this position, you will serve as an important point of contact for patients and healthcare providers, supporting both inbound patient calls and proactive outbound outreach. You will help patients with appointments, follow-ups, general nonclinical questions, and other patient-support needs while ensuring every interaction is handled professionally, accurately, and with care. This is a great opportunity for someone with healthcare, medical office, patient services, healthcare contact center, insurance, or scheduling experience who is comfortable working in a structured, high-accountability environment. What You'll Do Handle inbound patient calls, messages, appointment requests, callbacks, and general nonclinical inquiries. Schedule, reschedule, confirm, and cancel appointments according to established provider and workflow requirements. Make outbound calls for appointment follow-ups, Annual Wellness Visits, new initiatives, canceled or unconfirmed appointments, website requests, and other approved patient-engagement campaigns. Follow approved scripts for results-call workflows and appropriately route clinical questions to licensed staff. Support insurance verification and prior-authorization workflows within the assigned scope. Conduct approved Medicare, MIPS, HEDIS, and other patient outreach activities. Communicate clearly and patiently with patients, including older adults who may require additional explanation, repetition, or a slower speaking pace. Accurately document calls, patient interactions, appointment information, outcomes, messages, and follow-up requirements in the appropriate systems. Communicate patient needs, scheduling challenges, escalations, and unresolved issues to office staff. Maintain strong attendance, schedule adherence, productivity, quality, and patient-experience standards. Work From Home & Technical Requirements Company equipment will be provided. You will need: A reliable high-speed Ethernet connection with at least 25-30 Mbps download speed A dedicated, quiet, and secure workspace A professional wired USB headset Web-enabled camera and microphone Additional monitor(s) Schedule Monday-Friday | 8:00 AM-5:00 PM Pacific Time (Las Vegas) Weekends off Fully remote; work from home in Mexico Compensation & Contract $5.50 USD per hour 45 hours per week Paid weekly in arrears Independent Contractor position ﻿ ﻿Hiring Process To ensure fairness and consistency, all applicants must complete every stage of the hiring process. Our process includes: Resume Review Pre-Screen Questionnaire One-Way Video Interview Pre-Screen interview Live Interviews Background Check Please Note ﻿ This is an English-speaking role that requires strong written and verbal English communication skills. All resumes must be submitted in English to be considered for this position. ﻿ A background check might be required for candidates who are shortlisted as part of the final hiring process. Employment will be subject to successful completion of the applicable background check. Requirements What We're Looking For Fluent/professional English and Spanish, both spoken and written. At least 6 months of customer service experience in a doctor's office, clinic, healthcare contact center, insurance office, scheduling operation, or similar patient-support environment. Experience handling inbound calls and outbound follow-up in a structured environment. Strong attention to detail and accurate data entry skills. Excellent organization and follow-through. Ability to learn and consistently follow scripts, SOPs, workflows, escalation procedures, and documentation standards. Ability to multitask across phone systems, electronic medical records, online requests, and internal communications. Reliable attendance and strong schedule adherence. A dedicated, quiet, secure work-from-home environment suitable for handling confidential patient information. A secondary location available in case of a home internet or power outage. Preferred Experience Healthcare scheduling across multiple providers, clinics, or appointment types. Insurance verification or prior authorization. Medicare or Annual Wellness Visit outreach. MIPS or HEDIS workflows. Medical front desk, patient access, referrals, or back-office support. Experience with an EMR/EHR and contact-center telephony platform. Aprima or Intermedia/Elevate experience is a plus, but not required. Experience identifying patient-access barriers and suggesting practical workflow improvements. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/resolv-global-bilingual-patient-services-representative

title: SimpleTiger: Web Developer: WordPress & HubSpot (U.S. Based, Remote Contractor)
text: Headquarters: Sarasota, FL URL: https://www.simpletiger.com/ SimpleTiger is hiring a part-time contract web developer to build, improve, and troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot, with the potential to grow into a larger role. We’re a B2B SaaS marketing agency helping software companies grow through SEO, content marketing, paid media, and answer engine optimization (AEO). Our clients’ websites are where much of that work comes to life, and we’re looking for a developer who can turn ideas into clean, functional pages quickly. As part of our delivery team, you’ll work primarily on client websites, translating designs, campaign concepts, and SEO recommendations into effective web experiences. From building new pages to fixing issues on existing sites, you’ll help turn our marketing strategy into work that’s ready to launch. Key responsibilities Build, update, or troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot CMS Make technical fixes and improvements to live client sites, with clear details on what was tested, implemented, and performance comparisons using tools like Screaming Frog, pagespeed insights, and Lighthouse Build and connect forms, lead routing, and simple automations between a site and the client’s marketing tools Set up and check tracking, like GA4, Google Tag Manager, and HubSpot tracking in Tandem with the SEO Manager Keep sites fast, accessible, and friendly to SEO (page speed, Core Web Vitals, clean markup, image optimizations, cache lifetime improvements, and so on) Write clear and timely notes on what you are actively working on, and any updates pushed live so our team and the client can follow along Qualifications and skills You’re a hands-on developer who can build from scratch, troubleshoot existing sites, and make improvements without disrupting what’s already working. Required skills WordPress development: Strong experience with custom themes, child themes, blocks, page builders, and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF). You can build a page from the ground up—not just edit an existing one. HubSpot CMS development: Strong experience with HubL templates, modules, and themes, including building and troubleshooting pages, forms, and email templates. Front-end development: Solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript skills, with the ability to navigate existing code and understand how changes affect the live site. APIs and integrations: Experience working with the HubSpot or WordPress REST APIs, plus CRMs and marketing tools such as Salesforce, Zapier, n8n, Airtable, and Slack. Technical audits and fixes: Experience using Screaming Frog to audit WordPress and HubSpot sites, interpret findings, and resolve technical issues. Code review and cleanup: Comfort working within WordPress and HubSpot codebases to identify legacy or unused JavaScript and CSS, determine what’s still needed, and safely remove what isn’t. Async communication: Clear, timely written communication, especially through Slack. Independent work: Strong time management and the ability to meet deadlines, flag blockers early, and keep projects moving without close supervision. Nice-to-have skills Webflow development and auditing experience, including building a clean CMS structure. PHP development experience. Previous work at a marketing agency or with B2B SaaS clients. Familiarity with SEO and conversion best practices. Experience with Git and version control. What success looks like Success means delivering clean, reliable development work that helps our team turn marketing plans into live client experiences. Designs, campaign concepts, and SEO requests become functional pages in WordPress and HubSpot. Technical audit findings lead to practical fixes, with changes tested to avoid breaking existing functionality. Legacy and unused code is cleaned up thoughtfully, while essential code and front-end behavior remain intact. Forms, templates, and integrations work as intended and support the client’s marketing workflows. Projects stay on track because you manage your workload, meet agreed deadlines, and raise questions or blockers early. Teammates have clear visibility into progress through timely updates and straightforward communication in Slack. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/simpletiger-web-developer-wordpress-hubspot-u-s-based-remote-contractor
